blocks.original_text:
- name: int_greenhouse__application_info
      description: Integrated application snapshot with joins to candidate, job, activity, source, stage, and EEOC datasets
      grain: One row per application_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_greenhouse__application_users
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__application
      - intermediate.int_greenhouse__candidate_users
      - intermediate.int_greenhouse__candidate_tags
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__job_stage
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__source
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__activity
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__job_application
      - intermediate.int_greenhouse__job_info
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__eeoc
      business_logic: '- Start with intermediate.int_greenhouse__application_users (application) selecting all columns. - Left join staging.stg_greenhouse__application (staging_application) on application_id to add applied_at, current_stage_id, last_activity_at, prospect, and source_id from staging; because these names already exist in application.*, DuckDB emits the staging versions as applied_at_1, current_stage_id_2, last_activity_at_3, prospect_4, source_id_5; these staging-sourced fields are NULL if the staging row is missing. - Left join intermediate.int_greenhouse__candidate_users (candidate) on candidate_id to add current_title, current_company, first_contact_date, last_contact_date; also set primary_email = ''Unknown'', website = ''Unknown'', linkedin_url = ''Unknown'' for all rows; set candidate_created_at equal to staging_application.applied_at (NULL if staging_application is missing). - Left join intermediate.int_greenhouse__candidate_tags (candidate_tag) on candidate_id to bring in the pre-aggregated tag string as candidate_tags; NULL if no tag record. - Left join staging.stg_greenhouse__job_stage (job_stage) on staging_application.current_stage_id = job_stage.job_stage_id to add current_job_stage = job_stage.name; NULL if no stage match. - Left join staging.stg_greenhouse__source (source) on staging_application.source_id = source.source_id to add sourced_from = source.name and sourced_from_type = source.source_type_name; NULL if no source match. - Summarize staging.stg_greenhouse__activity by candidate_id as the total number of activity rows per candidate (count_activities); left join on candidate_id so it is NULL if the candidate has no activity rows. - Left join staging.stg_greenhouse__job_application (job_application) on application_id, then left join intermediate.int_greenhouse__job_info (job) on job_application.job_id = job.job_id to add job-related fields (title, status, managers, recruiters, requisition_id, sourcers, offices, departments, parent_departments); these are NULL when no matching job_application or job exists. - Left join staging.stg_greenhouse__eeoc (eeoc) on application_id to add candidate_gender, candidate_disability_status, candidate_race, and candidate_veteran_status; NULL if no EEOC record. - Set prospect_pool = ''Unknown'' and prospect_stage = ''Unknown'' constants for all rows. - Build application_job_key by concatenating application_id, a hyphen, and job_id rendered as text; when job_id is NULL, use the lowercase string "null" in place of job_id.'
      columns:
      - name: application_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique application identifier from application.*; one output row per application_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: candidate_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Candidate identifier from application.* used to join candidate, tags, and activity
      - name: applied_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Applied timestamp from application.*
      - name: current_stage_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Current stage ID from application.*
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application status from application.*
      - name: last_activity_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last activity timestamp from application.*
      - name: rejected_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Rejection timestamp from application.*
      - name: source_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Source ID from application.*
      - name: prospect
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Prospect flag from application.*
      - name: candidate_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name from application.*
      - name: candidate_company
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Company from application.*
      - name: referrer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Referrer name from application.*
      - name: prospect_owner_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Prospect owner name from application.*
      - name: applied_at_1
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Applied timestamp from staging_application; NULL if no staging match
      - name: current_stage_id_2
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Current stage ID from staging_application; NULL if no staging match
      - name: last_activity_at_3
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last activity timestamp from staging_application; NULL if no staging match
      - name: prospect_4
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Prospect flag from staging_application; NULL if no staging match
      - name: source_id_5
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Source ID from staging_application; NULL if no staging match
      - name: current_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current title from candidate users; NULL if no candidate match
      - name: current_company
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current company from candidate users; NULL if no candidate match
      - name: first_contact_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: First contact date from candidate users; NULL if no candidate match
      - name: last_contact_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last contact date from candidate users; NULL if no candidate match
      - name: primary_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant 'Unknown' for all rows; never NULL
      - name: website
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant 'Unknown' for all rows; never NULL
      - name: linkedin_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant 'Unknown' for all rows; never NULL
      - name: candidate_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Equal to staging_application.applied_at; NULL if staging_application is missing
      - name: candidate_tags
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pre-aggregated candidate tag string from candidate_tags; NULL if no tag record
      - name: current_job_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stage name from job_stage via current_stage_id; NULL if no stage match
      - name: sourced_from
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source name from source via source_id; NULL if no source match
      - name: sourced_from_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source type from source via source_id; NULL if no source match
      - name: count_activities
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total number of activity rows per candidate_id; NULL if the candidate has no activities
      - name: job_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Job name from job_info via job_application.job_id; NULL if no matching job
      - name: job_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Job status from job_info via job_application.job_id; NULL if no matching job
      - name: hiring_managers
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Hiring managers list from job_info; NULL if no matching job
      - name: recruiter_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recruiters list from job_info (aliased as recruiter_name); NULL if no matching job
      - name: job_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Job ID from job_application; NULL if no matching job_application
      - name: job_requisition_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Job requisition ID from job_info; NULL if no matching job
      - name: job_sourcers
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sourcers list from job_info; NULL if no matching job
      - name: job_offices
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Offices list from job_info; NULL if no matching job
      - name: job_departments
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Departments list from job_info; NULL if no matching job
      - name: job_parent_departments
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent departments list from job_info; NULL if no matching job
      - name: prospect_pool
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant 'Unknown' for all rows; never NULL
      - name: prospect_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant 'Unknown' for all rows; never NULL
      - name: candidate_gender
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: EEOC gender description joined by application_id; NULL if no EEOC record
      - name: candidate_disability_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: EEOC disability status description joined by application_id; NULL if no EEOC record
      - name: candidate_race
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: EEOC race description joined by application_id; NULL if no EEOC record
      - name: candidate_veteran_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: EEOC veteran status description joined by application_id; NULL if no EEOC record
      - name: application_job_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Concatenate application_id, a hyphen, and job_id rendered as text; when job_id is NULL use the lowercase string 'null' in place of job_id

references.name: intermediate.int_greenhouse__application_users
references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start with intermediate.int_greenhouse__application_users (application) selecting all columns. - Left join staging.stg_greenhouse__application (staging_application) on application_id to add applied_at, current_stage_id, last_activity_at, prospect, and source_id from staging; because these names already exist in application.*, DuckDB emits the staging versions as applied_at_1, current_stage_id_2, last_activity_at_3, prospect_4, source_id_5; these staging-sourced fields are NULL if the staging row is missing. - Left join intermediate.int_greenhouse__candidate_users (candidate) on candidate_id to add current_title, current_company, first_contact_date, last_contact_date; also set primary_email = ''Unknown'', website = ''Unknown'', linkedin_url = ''Unknown'' for all rows; set candidate_created_at equal to staging_application.applied_at (NULL if staging_application is missing). - Left join intermediate.int_greenhouse__candidate_tags (candidate_tag) on candidate_id to bring in the pre-aggregated tag string as candidate_tags; NULL if no tag record. - Left join staging.stg_greenhouse__job_stage (job_stage) on staging_application.current_stage_id = job_stage.job_stage_id to add current_job_stage = job_stage.name; NULL if no stage match. - Left join staging.stg_greenhouse__source (source) on staging_application.source_id = source.source_id to add sourced_from = source.name and sourced_from_type = source.source_type_name; NULL if no source match. - Summarize staging.stg_greenhouse__activity by candidate_id as the total number of activity rows per candidate (count_activities); left join on candidate_id so it is NULL if the candidate has no activity rows. - Left join staging.stg_greenhouse__job_application (job_application) on application_id, then left join intermediate.int_greenhouse__job_info (job) on job_application.job_id = job.job_id to add job-related fields (title, status, managers, recruiters, requisition_id, sourcers, offices, departments, parent_departments); these are NULL when no matching job_application or job exists. - Left join staging.stg_greenhouse__eeoc (eeoc) on application_id to add candidate_gender, candidate_disability_status, candidate_race, and candidate_veteran_status; NULL if no EEOC record. - Set prospect_pool = ''Unknown'' and prospect_stage = ''Unknown'' constants for all rows. - Build application_job_key by concatenating application_id, a hyphen, and job_id rendered as text; when job_id is NULL, use the lowercase string "null" in place of job_id.'

      - staging.stg_greenhouse__candidate

      - staging.stg_greenhouse__email_address

- name: int_greenhouse__candidate_tags
      description: Aggregates candidate tags into a single string, counts tag associations, and flags presence of technical or experience tags.
      grain: One row per candidate_id with at least one joined tag association
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__candidate_tag
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__candidate

      columns:
      - name: candidate_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Candidate identifier; one output row per candidate_id present after the inner joins.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name from the candidate source paired with candidate_id; may be NULL.
      - name: tags
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Concatenated tag names separated by ', '; duplicates kept; NULL tag names skipped; ordering unspecified; NULL if no non-null tag names.
      - name: tag_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total tag associations per candidate after joins, including rows where the tag name is NULL.
      - name: has_technical_tag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if any tag name includes 'technical' ignoring case; otherwise FALSE; never NULL.
      - name: has_experience_tag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if any tag name includes 'experience' ignoring case; otherwise FALSE; never NULL.

- name: int_greenhouse__candidate_users
      description: Candidate profile with first and last application interaction timestamps
      grain: One row per candidate_id with at least one application
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__application
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__candidate
      business_logic: '- Join applications to candidates on candidate_id using an inner join, so only candidates with applications are included. - For each candidate_id, carry through full_name, current_company, and current_title from the candidate record without modification. - Summarize the candidate''s application records: - first_contact_date is the earliest applied_at across that candidate''s applications. - last_contact_date is the latest last_activity_at across that candidate''s applications. - Null handling: when determining earliest/latest, NULL values are ignored; if all values for a candidate are NULL, the summary date is NULL. - Duplicate application rows do not change earliest/latest results. - No normalization of string fields; original casing and spacing are preserved. - Timestamps are preserved as in the source; no timezone conversion.'
      columns:
      - name: candidate_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Primary candidate identifier; appears once for candidates with at least one application
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Candidate full name from the candidate record; passed through unmodified
      - name: current_company
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current company from the candidate record; passed through unmodified; may be NULL
      - name: current_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current title from the candidate record; passed through unmodified; may be NULL

- name: int_greenhouse__hiring_team
      description: Aggregates user full names into role-based lists per job by joining hiring_team to user_emails and grouping by job_id.
      grain: One row per job_id with at least one matched user_id in intermediate.int_greenhouse__user_emails
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__hiring_team
      - intermediate.int_greenhouse__user_emails
      business_logic: '- Read staging.stg_greenhouse__hiring_team (job_id, user_id, hiring_team_role) and intermediate.int_greenhouse__user_emails (user_id, full_name). - Perform an inner join on user_id; rows without a matching user are removed. - For each joined row, derive four role-category name fields based on a case-insensitive substring check of hiring_team_role: * Recruiter: role contains "recruiter" * Hiring manager: role contains "hiring" followed later by "manager" * Coordinator: role contains "coordinator" * Sourcer: role contains "sourcer" A single row can contribute to multiple categories; if a category does not match, that row’s value for the category is NULL. - Group by job_id. For each category, concatenate all non-NULL full_name values using ", ": * Only non-NULL names are included; duplicates are kept; no ordering is enforced before concatenation. * If a job_id has no names for a category, the result for that category is NULL. - Output one row per job_id present after the inner join.'
      columns:
      - name: job_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Job identifier; exactly one row per job_id present after the inner join on user_id.
        tests:
        - unique
      - name: hiring_managers
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma-separated user full_name values for roles containing both 'hiring' then 'manager' (case-insensitive); delimiter ', '; order unspecified; duplicates kept; NULL names excluded; NULL if none; original name formatting preserved.
      - name: sourcers
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma-separated user full_name values for roles containing 'sourcer' (case-insensitive); delimiter ', '; order unspecified; duplicates kept; NULL names excluded; NULL if none; original name formatting preserved.
      - name: recruiters
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma-separated user full_name values for roles containing 'recruiter' (case-insensitive); delimiter ', '; order unspecified; duplicates kept; NULL names excluded; NULL if none; original name formatting preserved.
      - name: coordinators
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma-separated user full_name values for roles containing 'coordinator' (case-insensitive); delimiter ', '; order unspecified; duplicates kept; NULL names excluded; NULL if none; original name formatting preserved.

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_greenhouse__interview_scorecard
      description: Interview and scorecard details per scheduled interview and interviewer, with fallback interview name and exact duration in minutes.
      grain: One row per (scheduled_interview_id, interviewer_user_id); if no interviewer exists, a single row with interviewer_user_id NULL is produced.
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__scheduled_interview
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__scheduled_interviewer
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__scorecard
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__interview
      primary_key:
      - interview_scorecard_key
      business_logic: '- Begin with all rows from scheduled_interview. - Left join scheduled_interviewer on scheduled_interview_id; keep scheduled_interview rows without a match and set interviewer_user_id to NULL in that case. - Left join scorecard using the scorecard_id from scheduled_interviewer; scorecard fields remain NULL if there is no matching scorecard. - Left join interview on interview_id from scheduled_interview; interview fields remain NULL if there is no matching interview. - Set interview_name to interview.name when present; otherwise use scorecard.interview_name; if both are missing, leave it NULL; original casing and spacing are preserved. - Compute duration_interview_minutes as the minute difference between end_at and start_at (end minus start); returned as a DOUBLE, not rounded; NULL if either timestamp is NULL and may be negative if end_at precedes start_at. - Create interview_scorecard_key by concatenating scheduled_interview_id, a hyphen "-", and interviewer_user_id; represent a missing interviewer_user_id with the literal "no_interviewer".'
      columns:
      - name: application_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Application identifier from scheduled_interview; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Creation timestamp of the scheduled interview; pass-through from scheduled_interview.created_at; may be NULL.
      - name: end_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Scheduled interview end timestamp from scheduled_interview.end_at; used to compute duration; may be NULL.
      - name: scheduled_interview_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Identifier of the scheduled interview from scheduled_interview; used in joins and key construction; may be NULL.
      - name: interview_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Interview identifier from scheduled_interview; used to join interview; may be NULL.
      - name: location
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Interview location from scheduled_interview.location; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: organizer_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Organizer user ID from scheduled_interview.organizer_user_id; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: start_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Scheduled interview start timestamp from scheduled_interview.start_at; used to compute duration; may be NULL.
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Scheduled interview status from scheduled_interview.status; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: last_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last update timestamp of the scheduled interview from scheduled_interview.last_updated_at; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: job_stage_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Job stage ID from interview.job_stage_id via join on interview_id; may be NULL if no matching interview.
      - name: interview_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Interview name from interview when available; otherwise scorecard.interview_name; preserves original text; may be NULL.
      - name: duration_interview_minutes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Exact minutes between end_at and start_at (end minus start) as a DOUBLE; not rounded; NULL if either timestamp is NULL; may be negative.
      - name: scorecard_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Scorecard identifier joined via scheduled_interviewer.scorecard_id; NULL if no matching scorecard.
      - name: candidate_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Candidate identifier from scorecard.candidate_id; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: overall_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Overall recommendation from scorecard.overall_recommendation; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: scorecard_submitted_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Scorecard submission timestamp from scorecard.submitted_at; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: scorecard_submitted_by_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: User ID who submitted the scorecard from scorecard.submitted_by_user_id; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: scorecard_last_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last update timestamp of the scorecard from scorecard.last_updated_at; pass-through; may be NULL.
      - name: interviewer_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Interviewer user ID from scheduled_interviewer.interviewer_user_id; NULL when no interviewer row exists for the scheduled interview.
      - name: interview_scorecard_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Surrogate key formed by concatenating scheduled_interview_id, '-', and interviewer_user_id; when interviewer_user_id is NULL, the literal 'no_interviewer' is used.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique

      grain: One row per user_id from staging.stg_greenhouse__user
      source_models:

      description: Application status-change intervals enriched with candidate/job attributes and per-interval activity counts
      grain: One row per application_id per status-change interval (valid_from→valid_until)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__application_history
      - mart.greenhouse__application_enhanced
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__job_stage
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__activity
      business_logic: '- Build status-change intervals from staging.stg_greenhouse__application_history: - For each application_id, order records by updated_at ascending. - Set valid_from to updated_at of the record. - Set valid_until to the next updated_at for the same application_id; if none, use the current timestamp at query time. - Intervals are half-open: include valid_from, exclude valid_until. - Enrich each interval: - Inner join mart.greenhouse__application_enhanced on application_id to add candidate and job attributes. - Left join staging.stg_greenhouse__job_stage on new_stage_id = job_stage_id to add the stage name; if no match, the name is NULL. - Compute days_in_stage as the exact seconds between valid_until and valid_from divided by 86,400; fractional days with no rounding. - Count activities per interval: - Left join staging.stg_greenhouse__activity on candidate_id only; counts include all activities for the candidate across applications. - For each interval, count activity rows where created_at (as a timestamp) is on or after valid_from and before valid_until. - Duplicates are counted; rows with NULL created_at do not count; if a candidate has no matching activities, the count is 0. - One row is produced per application_id per interval with all selected attributes; the last open interval is time-variant because valid_until uses the current timestamp.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: greenhouse__candidate_summary
      description: Candidate-level aggregates of applications, interviews, and derived quality metrics
      grain: One row per candidate_id with total_applications > 0 or total_interviews > 0
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__candidate (candidate_id, first_name, last_name, full_name, current_company, current_title, created_at)
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__application (application_id, candidate_id, status, rejected_at, applied_at)
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__scheduled_interview (scheduled_interview_id, application_id)
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__scorecard (application_id, overall_recommendation)
      business_logic: '1) Build application aggregates: left join candidates (c) to applications (a) by candidate_id, keeping rows where c.candidate_id is not null. Per candidate_id compute: total_applications as the count of application rows; hired_count as the count where status is "hired"; active_count where status is "active"; rejected_count where rejected_at is present; first_application_date as the earliest applied_at; last_application_date as the latest applied_at. Assign candidate_status as: "Hired" if hired_count > 0; else "Active" if active_count > 0; else "Persistent" if total_applications > 2; else "Standard". 2) Build interview metrics: from applications (a) where a.candidate_id is not null, left join scheduled_interviews (si) and scorecards (sc), grouped by candidate_id. Compute total_interviews as the count of distinct scheduled_interview_id (ignores nulls). Compute positive_interviews as the count of scorecards where overall_recommendation is "strong_yes" or "yes" (counts all qualifying scorecards). Compute avg_interview_score as the average of mapped recommendations: strong_yes=4, yes=3, no=2, definitely_not=1; other or missing values are excluded from the average. 3) Join interview metrics to application aggregates on candidate_id; missing totals for interviews and positive_interviews are treated as 0; avg_interview_score remains null if no mapped scorecards exist. 4) Derive metrics: personal_hire_rate = hired_count × 100 / total_applications when total_applications > 0, else 0. Interview_success_rate = positive_interviews × 100 / total_interviews when total_interviews > 0, else 0. Candidate_quality_score is set to 85 if hired_count > 0 and avg_interview_score ≥ 3.5; 70 if hired_count > 0; 60 if active_count > 0 and avg_interview_score ≥ 3.0; 50 if active_count > 0; 30 if total_applications > 2; otherwise 20. 5) Keep candidates with total_applications > 0 or total_interviews > 0. Sort by candidate_quality_score descending, then hired_count descending.'
      columns:
      - name: candidate_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique candidate key; one output row per candidate_id that meets the final filter
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Direct pass-through of the candidate’s first name; may be null
      - name: last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Direct pass-through of the candidate’s last name; may be null
      - name: full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Direct pass-through of the candidate’s full name; not constructed here; may be null
      - name: current_company
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Direct pass-through of the candidate’s current company; may be null
      - name: current_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Direct pass-through of the candidate’s current title; may be null
      - name: candidate_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp when the candidate record was created in the source
      - name: total_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of non-null application rows linked to the candidate; duplicates counted
      - name: hired_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of the candidate’s applications with status equal to 'hired'
      - name: active_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of the candidate’s applications with status equal to 'active'
      - name: rejected_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of the candidate’s applications where rejected_at is present, regardless of status
      - name: first_application_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest applied_at across the candidate’s applications; null if none available
      - name: last_application_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest applied_at across the candidate’s applications; null if none available
      - name: candidate_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Classification: Hired if hired_count>0; else Active if active_count>0; else Persistent if total_applications>2; else Standard'
      - name: total_interviews
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct scheduled_interview_id across the candidate’s applications; returned as 0 when not available
      - name: positive_interviews
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of scorecards with a 'strong_yes' or 'yes' recommendation; counts all qualifying scorecards; returned as 0 when not available
      - name: avg_interview_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average mapped score from scorecards (strong_yes=4, yes=3, no=2, definitely_not=1); excludes unmapped or null values; may be null
      - name: personal_hire_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent as hired_count*100/total_applications when total_applications>0, otherwise 0; not rounded
      - name: interview_success_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent as positive_interviews*100/total_interviews when total_interviews>0, otherwise 0; numerator counts scorecards and denominator counts distinct interviews
      - name: candidate_quality_score
        data_type: INTEGER

blocks.original_text:
- name: greenhouse__diversity_metrics
      description: Quarterly DEI metrics aggregated from applications and EEOC data (one row per year-quarter with at least 5 applications)
      grain: One row per application_year and application_quarter where total_applications >= 5
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__application
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__eeoc
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_greenhouse__application and keep only rows with applied_at present. - Left join staging.stg_greenhouse__eeoc on application_id; no de-duplication is applied, so multiple EEOC rows per application will inflate counts. - Derived fields per application: - application_year and application_quarter taken from applied_at (quarters 1–4). - is_hired = 1 when status equals ''hired'' exactly, else 0. - Dimension text filled with defaults: gender, race, veteran_status, disability_status are set to ''Unknown'' when the EEOC value is NULL. - Flags using exact string matches (case and spacing preserved; NULLs do not match): - is_female = 1 when EEOC gender_description is ''Female'' or ''Woman''. - Male counts use the gender dimension (with ''Unknown'' for NULL) equal to ''Male''. - is_non_white = 1 when EEOC race_description is present and not in {''White'',''Caucasian'',''Unknown'',''''}. - White counts use the race dimension (with ''Unknown'' for NULL) equal to ''White'' or ''Caucasian''. - is_veteran = 1 when EEOC veteran_status_description is ''Yes''. - has_disability = 1 when EEOC disability_status_description is ''Yes''. - Aggregate by application_year and application_quarter: - total_applications is the number of joined rows. - total_hires is the number of rows with is_hired = 1. - Group applications are the number of rows meeting each group condition; group hires require both the group condition and is_hired = 1. - Rows that do not meet a condition (including NULL/Unknown unless explicitly matched) are not counted for that metric. - Compute percentages (0–100) without rounding and return 0 when the denominator is 0: - overall_hire_rate = total_hires divided by total_applications. - Group hire rates = group_hires divided by group_applications. - Group hire representation = group_hires divided by total_hires. - diversity_assessment: - Good Diversity when there are at least 5 hires and the combined share of female_hires plus non_white_hires is at least 40%. - Moderate Diversity when there are at least 3 hires and that combined share is at least 30%. - Low Diversity when there is at least 1 hire. - No Hires otherwise. - Keep only year-quarters with total_applications >= 5. - Final ordering is by application_year descending, then application_quarter descending.'
      columns:
      - name: application_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar year from applied_at.
      - name: application_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar quarter number (1–4) from applied_at.
      - name: total_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of joined application rows in the year-quarter; at least 5 due to the final filter.
      - name: total_hires
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of rows with status exactly 'hired' in the year-quarter; duplicates from the join are included.
      - name: female_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of rows where EEOC gender_description is 'Female' or 'Woman'; exact matches; duplicates included.
      - name: female_hires
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of hired rows where EEOC gender_description is 'Female' or 'Woman'; exact matches; duplicates included.
      - name: male_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of rows where the gender dimension equals 'Male'; 'Unknown' and NULL do not count; duplicates included.
      - name: male_hires
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of hired rows where the gender dimension equals 'Male'; duplicates included.
      - name: non_white_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of rows where EEOC race_description is present and not 'White', 'Caucasian', 'Unknown', or empty; duplicates included.
      - name: non_white_hires
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of hired rows meeting the non-white condition above; duplicates included.
      - name: white_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of rows where the race dimension equals 'White' or 'Caucasian'; 'Unknown' and NULL do not count; duplicates included.
      - name: white_hires
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of hired rows where the race dimension equals 'White' or 'Caucasian'; duplicates included.
      - name: veteran_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of rows where EEOC veteran_status_description equals 'Yes'; duplicates included.
      - name: veteran_hires
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of hired rows where EEOC veteran_status_description equals 'Yes'; duplicates included.
      - name: disability_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of rows where EEOC disability_status_description equals 'Yes'; duplicates included.
      - name: disability_hires
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of hired rows where EEOC disability_status_description equals 'Yes'; duplicates included.
      - name: overall_hire_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage (0–100) of total_hires over total_applications; 0 when total_applications is 0; unrounded.
      - name: female_hire_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage (0–100) of female_hires over female_applications; 0 when female_applications is 0; unrounded.
      - name: male_hire_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage (0–100) of male_hires over male_applications; 0 when male_applications is 0; unrounded.
      - name: female_hire_representation
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage (0–100) of total hires that are female; 0 when total_hires is 0; unrounded.
      - name: non_white_hire_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage (0–100) of non_white_hires over non_white_applications; 0 when non_white_applications is 0; unrounded.
      - name: white_hire_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage (0–100) of white_hires over white_applications; 0 when white_applications is 0; unrounded.
      - name: non_white_hire_representation
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage (0–100) of total hires that are non-white; 0 when total_hires is 0; unrounded.
      - name: veteran_hire_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage (0–100) of veteran_hires over veteran_applications; 0 when veteran_applications is 0; unrounded.
      - name: veteran_hire_representation
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage (0–100) of total hires that are veterans; 0 when total_hires is 0; unrounded.
      - name: disability_hire_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage (0–100) of disability_hires over disability_applications; 0 when disability_applications is 0; unrounded.
      - name: disability_hire_representation
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage (0–100) of total hires that report a disability; 0 when total_hires is 0; unrounded.
      - name: diversity_assessment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Category: Good Diversity (>=5 hires and >=40% female+non-white), Moderate Diversity (>=3 hires and >=30%), Low Diversity (>=1 hire), else No Hires.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: greenhouse__job_enhanced
      description: Enhanced job facts with applications, interviews, ratings, conversion rates, and time-derived fields per job
      grain: One row per job_id; if multiple distinct hiring team combinations exist for a job_id, one row per distinct combination
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_greenhouse__job_info
      - intermediate.int_greenhouse__hiring_team
      - intermediate.int_greenhouse__application_info
      - intermediate.int_greenhouse__interview_scorecard
      business_logic: '- Start with all jobs from intermediate.int_greenhouse__job_info (job_id, name, status, requisition_id, created_at, departments, offices). - Build hiring_teams from intermediate.int_greenhouse__hiring_team by selecting job_id, hiring_managers, recruiters, sourcers and removing exact duplicate rows; if a job has multiple distinct combinations, all persist and create multiple output rows. - Build application_stats by job_id from intermediate.int_greenhouse__application_info: - Total applications: number of application rows. - Active applications: rows where status equals ''active''. - Hired applications: rows where status equals ''hired''. - Rejected applications: rows where status equals ''rejected''. - Prospect applications: rows where prospect equals the string ''True''. Notes: all comparisons are exact, case-sensitive. - Build interview_stats by joining interview scorecards to applications on application_id and aggregating by job_id: - Total interviews: number of scorecards for the job. - Completed interviews: scorecards where status equals ''completed''. - Average interviews per application: total scorecards divided by the count of distinct applications that have at least one scorecard; returns NULL if there are none. - Average job rating: mean of mapped recommendations (definitely_not→1, no→2, yes→3, strong_yes→4); other values and NULLs are excluded. - Rated applications count: number of scorecards with a non-NULL recommendation (counts scorecards, not distinct applications). - Rating completion rate: constant 1.0 for jobs with at least one scorecard. - Create the final set by left joining jobs to hiring_teams, application_stats, and interview_stats on job_id: - Pass through job and hiring team fields. - Replace NULLs in all count fields with 0; keep averages and rating_completion_rate as returned (they will be NULL when no scorecards exist for the job). - Conversion rates (percent, 0–100, no rounding): - Application to interview: if total applications > 0, total interviews divided by total applications times 100; otherwise 0. - Interview to hire: if total interviews > 0, hired applications divided by total interviews times 100; otherwise 0. - Overall conversion: if total applications > 0, hired applications divided by total applications times 100; otherwise 0. - Time fields: created_year and created_month from created_at; days_since_created is the number of days between the current date and created_at and may be fractional.'
      columns:
      - name: job_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique job identifier; determines row granularity
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Job name from job_info
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Job status from job_info
      - name: requisition_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Requisition identifier; may be NULL
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Job creation timestamp; used to derive year, month, and days_since_created
      - name: departments
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Departments from job_info
      - name: offices
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Offices from job_info
      - name: hiring_managers
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Hiring managers from hiring_team; NULL if no team row
      - name: recruiters
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recruiters from hiring_team; NULL if no team row
      - name: sourcers
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sourcers from hiring_team; NULL if no team row
      - name: count_total_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total applications for the job; NULL replaced with 0
      - name: count_active_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Applications with status='active'; NULL replaced with 0
      - name: count_hired_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Applications with status='hired'; NULL replaced with 0
      - name: count_rejected_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Applications with status='rejected'; NULL replaced with 0
      - name: count_prospect_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Applications where prospect equals 'True' (case-sensitive); NULL replaced with 0
      - name: count_total_interviews
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of interview scorecards for the job; NULL replaced with 0
      - name: count_completed_interviews
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Scorecards with status='completed'; NULL replaced with 0
      - name: avg_interviews_per_application
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total scorecards divided by distinct applications with a scorecard; NULL if none; no rounding
      - name: avg_job_rating
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average mapped recommendation (definitely_not=1, no=2, yes=3, strong_yes=4); excludes other values and NULLs; NULL if none
      - name: count_rated_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Scorecards with a non-NULL recommendation (counts scorecards, not distinct applications); NULL replaced with 0
      - name: rating_completion_rate
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: Constant 1.0 when at least one scorecard exists for the job; NULL otherwise
      - name: application_to_interview_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Percent: total interviews / total applications × 100; returns 0 if total applications is 0 or missing; no rounding'
      - name: interview_to_hire_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Percent: hired applications / total interviews × 100; returns 0 if total interviews is 0 or missing; no rounding'
      - name: overall_conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Percent: hired applications / total applications × 100; returns 0 if total applications is 0 or missing; no rounding'
      - name: created_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Year extracted from created_at
      - name: created_month
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Month (1–12) extracted from created_at
      - name: days_since_created
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Days between the current date and created_at; updates daily and may be fractional

exclude non-computable durations; no rounding. - Build interview_metrics: - From job_application joined to application (applied_at populated), left join scheduled_interview and scorecard. - Group by job_id and applied_at year and quarter. - Compute: - total_interviews: distinct count of scheduled_interview_id. - completed_interviews: count of scheduled interviews with status "completed" (not distinct). - total_scorecards: distinct count of scorecard_id. - avg_interview_score: average of mapped recommendations across scorecards (strong_yes=4, yes=3, no=2, definitely_not=1);       description: Simplified talent pipeline and source effectiveness by source and year-quarter; rows require at least one application
      grain: One row per source_id, source_name, source_type, application_year, application_quarter with total_applications >= 1
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__application
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__source
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__scheduled_interview
      business_logic: '- Keep applications where applied_at and source_id are present. - Enrich with source_name and source_type via a left join on source_id; if no source match, name/type are NULL. - Derive application_year and application_quarter from applied_at. - Group by source_id, source_name, source_type, application_year, application_quarter. - Aggregations per group: * total_applications: number of application rows. * unique_candidates: count of distinct non-null candidate_id values. * total_hires: applications with status exactly "hired" (string match is exact and case-sensitive). * active_applications: applications with status exactly "active". * rejected_applications: applications where rejected_at is present. * applications_with_interviews: applications that have at least one scheduled interview linked by application_id; each application counted once regardless of interview count. * avg_process_days: for each application, compute days from applied_at to rejected_at if present, otherwise to last_activity_at; average these durations; applications lacking both end timestamps do not contribute. - Metrics (expressed as percentages from 0 to 100, no rounding): * hire_rate: total_hires divided by total_applications; 0 if total_applications is 0. * interview_rate: applications_with_interviews divided by total_applications; 0 if total_applications is 0. * interview_to_hire_rate: total_hires divided by applications_with_interviews; 0 if no interviewed applications. * rejection_rate: rejected_applications divided by total_applications; 0 if total_applications is 0. - Rankings per year-quarter: * hire_rate_rank: rank by hire_rate descending (ties share rank; gaps allowed). * volume_rank: rank by total_applications descending (ties share rank; gaps allowed). - performance_tier: assign in order—High Performer (hire_rate ≥ 20 and total_applications ≥ 10), Good Performer (hire_rate ≥ 10 and total_applications ≥ 5), High Volume (total_applications ≥ 10), Medium Volume (total_applications ≥ 5), else Low Volume. - efficiency_score: if total_applications > 0, hire_rate + (total_applications ÷ 10); otherwise 0; no rounding. - Exclude groups with total_applications < 1. - Order rows by application_year descending, application_quarter descending, then efficiency_score descending.'
